data_object_lifecycle_states:210.description: Scorecard submitted and locked; hire/no-hire recommendation recorded.

trigger_events:62.description: Fired when a Job Requisition is approved. Publisher domain owns the state transition; subscribers may react by creating downstream artifacts.

handoffs:121.handoff_label: Applicant Tracking and Recruiting → Compensation Management : job_offer.signed
handoffs:121.description: Offer signature instantiates the new-hire compensation plan (base, target bonus, equity grant, sign-on) in COMP-MGMT.

handoffs:398.handoff_label: Applicant Tracking and Recruiting → Compensation Management : job_offer.signed
handoffs:398.description: Signed offer establishes the comp baseline; COMP-MGMT incorporates into cycle history.
handoffs:398.notes: COMP-MGMT does not master job_offers; payload sits in ATS. No defensible COMP-MGMT module pick.

trigger_events:365.description: A hire is attributed to a sourcing channel (job board, referral, agency, event). Drives cost-per-hire analytics and channel ROI.

trigger_events:368.description: Candidate added to a passive talent pool (silver-medalist, leadership pipeline, returnee). Marketing nurture and recruiter outreach pickup.

trigger_events:369.description: Pool candidate re-engaged for an open requisition. Application is created; sourcing attribution flows.

handoffs:14.handoff_label: Strategic Workforce Planning → Applicant Tracking and Recruiting : headcount.approved
handoffs:14.description: Approved headcount in SWP authorizes requisition creation in ATS. THIS IS THE CO-MASTER BRIDGE: SWP masters the intent slice (approved position, budget, time window) and ATS masters the execution slice (pipeline, candidates, interviews, offer). High friction because SWP's plan structure (org × geo × level × time) rarely matches ATS's requisition template structure (job code × location × hiring manager × pay range), requiring mapping rules that drift as either side evolves.

handoffs:1149.handoff_label: Strategic Workforce Planning → Strategic Workforce Planning : headcount.approved
handoffs:1149.description: Approved headcount triggers cost-projection refresh: cost-projections rolls the new requisition load into the loaded-comp envelope.

handoffs:406.handoff_label: Applicant Tracking and Recruiting → Human Capital Management : headcount.approved
handoffs:406.description: Headcount approval (often originating from HCM/SWP) confirmed back to HCM; gives ATS green light to source.
